## CodeQL / Cleartext logging of sensitive information

This operation writes [checks.trusted()](1) to a log file.
This operation writes [parse_dl_certificate(...)](2) to a log file.

[Show more details](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/purrdf/security/code-scanning/240)

Reviewed alert240 against the actual source. This sink is the ignored, cfg(test) seal_schema_vectors fixture generator, which reads only the fixed cases() public example.org ontologies and writes the deliberate proof/check golden artifact tests/fixtures/dl-proof.vectors. checks.trusted() is the count of proof premises, not a credential; the parsed certificate likewise comes exclusively from those authored fixtures. No caller input, secret or production logging path reaches this sink. We decline this finding as a false positive and retain the complete golden output so independent native/C/Python/WASM proof checking remains reproducible.
